editorial_plan.central_question: 当两家车企宣布采用相近的NVIDIA计算、传感器及驾驶软件架构时，这能为购车者提供什么信息，还需要哪些证据才能判断具体车辆的功能和安全性？
editorial_plan.title: 奔驰与沃尔沃采用相近的自动驾驶技术，购车者能据此相信什么？

summary: 奔驰与沃尔沃宣布扩大NVIDIA合作，计划采用若干同名驾驶技术。公告说明了研发方向，但具体车辆的交付功能、运行条件、乘员义务和安全结果仍未确定。购车者需要核对将这些计划连接到所购车辆的功能文件、验证材料和交付记录。
summary_en: Mercedes-Benz and Volvo Cars have announced expanded NVIDIA partnerships involving similarly named driving technologies. The announcements describe development plans but leave vehicle-specific functions, operating conditions, occupant obligations and safety outcomes unresolved. Buyers need documents and evidence connecting those plans to the vehicle they intend to purchase.
title: 奔驰与沃尔沃计划采用相近驾驶技术，购车者能据此判断什么？
title_en: Mercedes-Benz and Volvo plan to use similar driving technologies. What can buyers infer?
